Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
FYI:

The tournament at 12:00 Saturday (Event# 660031) is a DCI sanctioned
tournament, and all DCI floor rules will be in force.

The sealed-deck tournament at 10:00 Friday (Event# 660102) is a
limited event using Rochester Draft rules, and is not sanctioned.

That's all the information that I have at this time.

For more information on Gen*Con, see the TSR web page:
http://www.tsrinc.com/gencon/GenCon97.html

or e-mail TSR...@aol.com

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@regency.wizards.com)
Official VtES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
(*) - Subject to review by Rules Team
